content.title: Live Updates: Scores, Updates and Highlights across the NBA
content.text: What We Know After Thursday’s Games Knicks Defeat Celtics on Prime: This is a potential playoff preview, and fans were rewarded with a gem. There were 13 ties and 16 lead changes in total, with New York prevailing behind a 31-23 fourth quarter. Jalen Brunson and Karl-Anthony Towns both recorded double-doubles. Rockets Defeat Sixers on League Pass: Houston had a 23-point lead headed into the fourth quarter in this double-digit win. Kevin Durant led the way with 29 points, seven rebounds and five assists. Lakers Blowout the Warriors on Prime: Los Angeles needed this win to tie the Houston Rockets for fourth in the West. Both of those teams are one game back of the Denver Nuggets in third. LeBron James had a vintage performance, collecting 26 points, six rebounds and 11 assists. Top Performers of the Night -LeBron James had 26 points, six rebounds and 11 assists in a blowout victory over the Golden State Warriors. -Kevin Durant collected 29 points, seven rebounds and five assists in a win over the Philadelphia 76ers. -Obi Toppin tallied 26 points, nine rebounds and three assists across 18 minutes in a win over the Brooklyn Nets. -Jayson Tatum totaled 24 points, 13 rebounds and eight assists in a loss to the New York Knicks. -Jalen Brunson had 25 points and 10 assists in that victory. -Will Riley registered 23 points, nine rebounds, seven assists, three steals and three blocks in a defeat against the Chicago Bulls. -Tre Jones led Chicago with 31 points, six rebounds and three assists in that win. -Leonard Miller amassed a career-high 26 points, 11 rebounds and three assists for the Bulls as well. -Brandon Ingram accrued 38 points, seven rebounds and seven assists in a win over the Miami Heat. -Bam Adebayo had 24 points, 11 rebounds and eight assists in that defeat.
